Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(janitor)
library(data.table) 
library(splitstackshape) 
library(survival)
library(survminer)
```
Read in Kyn1 data for lifespan
```{r,read in Kyn1 data}
Kyn1Lifespan <- read.csv("data/Kyn1/Kyn1Lifespan.csv")
Kyn1Lifespan$treatment <- factor(Kyn1Lifespan$treatment, levels = c("KynA","Kynurenine","DMSO"))
Kyn1Lifespan$group <- factor(Kyn1Lifespan$group, levels = c("Orange","Green1","Green2","Pink"))
Kyn1Lifespan$dose <- factor(Kyn1Lifespan$dose, levels = c("0mg/mL","1mg/mL","3mg/mL"))
Kyn1Lifespan$sex<-factor(Kyn1Lifespan$sex)
#Formatting for survfit
Deaths<-expandRows(Kyn1Lifespan%>%select(age.d,treatment,group,dose,vial,sex,dead,dateEclosed),"dead")
Deaths$deaths<-1
Deaths$censored<-0
Censored<-expandRows(Kyn1Lifespan%>%select(age.d,treatment,group,dose,vial,sex,censored,dateEclosed),"censored")
Censored$deaths<-0
Censored$censored<-1
data<-rbind(Deaths,Censored)
#clear environment
rm(Deaths,Censored)
```

Kaplan Meier for Kyn1
```{r}
data2<-data
my_colors <- c("orange", "purple")

fit.sex<-survfit(Surv(age.d,deaths)~sex, data=data2)
ggsurvplot(
  fit.sex,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  xlab = "Time (days)",
  title = "Kyn1 experiment, w[1118] obs=928",
  pval = TRUE,
  palette = my_colors,
    xlim = c(0, 80)  # Set the x-axis limits from 0 to 80

)

female<-data%>%filter(sex=="Female")
fit.groupF<-survfit(Surv(age.d,deaths)~treatment+dose, data=female)
# Use the ggsurvplot function with the custom group variable and customized labels
ggsurvplot(
  fit.groupF,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  xlab = "Time (days)",
  title = "Kyn1 experiment, females w[1118] obs=443",
  pval = TRUE,
    xlim = c(0, 80)  # Set the x-axis limits from 0 to 80

)

male<-data%>%filter(sex=="Male")
fit.groupM<-survfit(Surv(age.d,deaths)~treatment+dose, data=male)
# Use the ggsurvplot function with the custom group variable and customized labels
ggsurvplot(
  fit.groupM,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  xlab = "Time (days)",
  title = "Kyn1 experiment, males w[1118] obs=485",
  pval = TRUE,
    xlim = c(0, 80)  # Set the x-axis limits from 0 to 80

)

DMSO<-data%>%filter(group=="Orange")
KynA1<-data%>%filter(group=="Green1")
KynA2<-data%>%filter(group=="Green2")
Kyn<-data%>%filter(group=="Pink")
DMSO<-data%>%filter(treatment=="DMSO")

fit.DMSO<-survfit(Surv(age.d,deaths)~sex, data=DMSO)
ggsurvplot(
  fit.DMSO,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  xlab = "Time (days)",
  title = "DMSO group, w[1118] obs=345",
  pval = TRUE,
  palette = my_colors,
    xlim = c(0, 80)  # Set the x-axis limits from 0 to 80

)
fit.KynA1<-survfit(Surv(age.d,deaths)~sex, data=KynA1)
ggsurvplot(
  fit.KynA1,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  xlab = "Time (days)",
  title = "KynA 1mg/mL group, w[1118] obs=226",
  pval = TRUE,
  palette = my_colors,
    xlim = c(0, 80)  # Set the x-axis limits from 0 to 80

)
fit.KynA2<-survfit(Surv(age.d,deaths)~sex, data=KynA2)
ggsurvplot(
  fit.KynA2,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  xlab = "Time (days)",
  title = "KynA 3mg/mL group, w[1118] obs=178",
  pval = TRUE,
  palette = my_colors,
    xlim = c(0, 80)  # Set the x-axis limits from 0 to 80

)
fit.Kyn<-survfit(Surv(age.d,deaths)~sex, data=Kyn)
ggsurvplot(
  fit.Kyn,
  conf.int = FALSE,
  xlab = "Time (days)",
  title = "Kynurenine 1mg/mL group, w[1118] obs=179",
  pval = TRUE,
  palette = my_colors,
    xlim = c(0, 80)  # Set the x-axis limits from 0 to 80

)


```
